name: Virtualisation software
definition: Program that runs one or more virtual machines or whole guest systems on the owner's computer.
notes: Wikipedia comparison lists VMware Workstation/Fusion, VirtualBox, Parallels Desktop, Hyper-V, QEMU as platform virtualization software

name: Backup and disk-cloning software
definition: Program that copies files, a disk or a whole system image to the owner's own drives (backup to the provider's servers is a plan, I3).
notes: List splits backup tools from disk imaging (Macrium Reflect, Norton Ghost, Image for Windows); backup apps and disk imaging listed together

name: Data-erasure software
definition: Program that overwrites storage so that the erased data cannot be recovered.
notes: Page lists data-erasing tools incl. BleachBit, DBAN, Eraser, ShredIt

name: File archiver
definition: Program that packs files into compressed archives and unpacks them.
notes: Wikipedia comparison of file archivers; 7-Zip, WinRAR, WinZip, PeaZip

name: Disc-burning software
definition: Program that writes data, audio or disc images to optical discs.
notes: Wikipedia list of optical disc authoring software; Nero Burning ROM, Roxio Creator, ImgBurn

name: Password manager
definition: Program or hosted tool that stores, generates and fills passwords and logins; family, premium and free plans are variants.
notes: Wikipedia list of password managers; 1Password, Bitwarden, KeePass, LastPass

name: Office suite
definition: Bundle of word-processing, spreadsheet and presentation programs sold as one product.
notes: Wikipedia list of office suites; free and open-source, proprietary and discontinued

name: PDF reader and editor
definition: Program that views, annotates, edits, fills or signs PDF files.
notes: Wikipedia list of PDF software with readers and editors per platform

name: Personal-finance manager [家計簿]
definition: Program for tracking accounts, budgets and household money.
notes: Wikipedia list of personal finance software; GnuCash, Quicken, YNAB

name: Code editor and IDE
definition: Program for writing, running and debugging source code.
notes: Wikipedia list of IDEs; code editors listed by language and licence

name: Application launcher
definition: Program that opens applications, files and commands from a typed name or shortcut.
notes: Wikipedia comparison of desktop application launchers (Alfred, LaunchBar, Raycast)

name: 3D modelling software
definition: Program for modelling, sculpting and rendering three-dimensional objects.
notes: Wikipedia list of 3D modeling software (Blender, Cinema 4D, ZBrush)

name: Screen recorder and live-streaming software
definition: Program that records the screen or camera and streams it live; kept as one kind until a source separates the two.
notes: Comparison of screencasting software lists recorders and broadcasters in one table (Camtasia, OBS Studio)

name: Audio editor
definition: Program for recording, editing and mastering sound.
notes: Music software list has a separate wave-editors section (Audacity, Audition, WaveLab, Sound Forge)

name: Music-creation and recording software
definition: Program for composing, arranging and recording music.
notes: Music software list has a DAW section (Ableton Live, Cubase, Logic Pro, FL Studio)

name: Accounting software
definition: Program for bookkeeping, invoicing and financial reporting for a business or a freelancer.
notes: Comparison of accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, FreshBooks, FreeAgent, MYOB)

name: CRM software
definition: Program for managing customer contacts, deals and sales follow-up.
notes: Comparison of CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive)

name: Version-control client
definition: Program for tracking and sharing changes to source code.
notes: Comparison of version-control software (Git, Mercurial, Subversion, Perforce)

name: Raster image editor
definition: Program for editing and painting pixel-based images.
notes: Comparison of raster graphics editors (GIMP, Photoshop, Affinity Photo)

name: Vector graphics editor
definition: Program for drawing and editing shape-based graphics that scale without loss.
notes: Comparison of vector graphics editors (Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Inkscape)

name: Video editor
definition: Program for cutting, arranging and finishing video.
notes: Comparison of video editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro)

name: Video converter
definition: Program that converts video and audio files between formats and settings.
notes: Comparison of free video converters (HandBrake, Any Video Converter, Freemake)

name: VPN service and client
definition: VPN client, with the service it connects to, that encrypts the owner's connection and routes it through a private network.
notes: VPN service article tables compare VPN providers (client + service) NordVPN, ExpressVPN, Mullvad

name: Remote-desktop software
definition: Program that shows and controls another computer's screen over a network.
notes: Desktop sharing article compares TeamViewer, RealVNC, Splashtop, Chrome Remote Desktop; remote control and screen sharing are mixed

name: Antivirus and security suite
definition: Program that protects a computer or phone from malware and online threats; free antivirus, internet-security and total-security editions are one kind.
notes: Category of antivirus products: Kaspersky Anti-Virus, Internet Security, Norton 360, Bitdefender
